**Subject:** Recommendations for Updating the Customer Database

Hi Kyle,

Here are my main recommendations:

```{=latex}
\begin{center}
\small
\begin{tabular}{|l|l|}
\hline
\cellcolor{issuepink}\textbf{Issue} & \cellcolor{fixgreen}\textbf{Proposed fix} \\
\hline
\cellcolor{issuepink}\begin{minipage}[t]{0.38\textwidth}
Some customer records are more than five years old.
\end{minipage} &
\cellcolor{fixgreen}\begin{minipage}[t]{0.44\textwidth}
Review old records and see if we should keep, update, or delete them.
\end{minipage} \\
\hline
\cellcolor{issuepink}\begin{minipage}[t]{0.38\textwidth}
The old database is not compatible with the new mailing software.
\end{minipage} &
\cellcolor{fixgreen}\begin{minipage}[t]{0.44\textwidth}
Create a new database in Access. Talk to IT first before we change anything.
\end{minipage} \\
\hline
\cellcolor{issuepink}\begin{minipage}[t]{0.38\textwidth}
The old and new systems cannot merge files easily.
\end{minipage} &
\cellcolor{fixgreen}\begin{minipage}[t]{0.44\textwidth}
Move to the new database step by step with help from IT.
\end{minipage} \\
\hline
\end{tabular}
\end{center}
\normalsize
```

I also have some questions:

- Do we want to improve the database, or start a campaign with old customers?
- How is this connected to our email database?
- There are many inconsistencies. Is this the correct database for this analysis?

I think we should share this with other teams before we do anything. This way we don't affect other work in the company.

Please let me know what you think.
